thread:
sarah: Heads-up  AstraMetrics says they saw a 5x usage spike on 2026-12-03 and were billed $9,600 for the surge. They claim the spike was caused by an internal test API key that was accidentally promoted to prod during a pricing-experiment rollout. Can we investigate and propose a remediation?

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice AMT-8811 (2026-12-05) attached. Charge breakdown: Base plan $3,000 + Overage surge $9,600 = Total $12,600.

leo: Did the key belong to them or our test org? Need to trace the key id and token provenance.

jen: Confirmed: key id test-xxxx was part of the "rapid-retry-v2" pricing experiment. On 2026-12-03 the feature toggled a config and flagged a subset of test keys as active in prod due to a mapping bug (PR #4829). Evidence: deploy logs + experiment trace.

sarah: Ok, so root cause is our experiment. What's the right customer outcome? Full refund of the surge? Partial? Any goodwill?

ops-bot: [automated] Experiment rapid-retry-v2 was rolled back at 2026-12-03T14:52:10Z. Affected keys: test-xxxx, test-zz12. Total affected requests counted: 1,280 (estimated).

leo: Quick math: surge charge $9,600. If we refund full amount that's $9,600. Proposal: full reversal of surge + $300 goodwill credit for the ops disruption. GLs: AR-Adj (6150), Promo-Grant (7455). Approval needed from finance lead for >$5k.

sarah: I approve the full $9,600 reversal and the $300 goodwill credit. Approve up to $10k. Mark memo: "experiment-misflag-testkey" and tag cost center COGS-SaaS.

billing-bot: [automated] Created adjustment ADJ-8890. Credits applied: $9,900 (includes goodwill). Updated invoice AMT-8811-v2.pdf. Accounting refs: ADJ-8890 / AR-6150 / PROMO-7455.

leo: Recommend we also issue a follow-up to explain next steps and offer to prioritize a re-onboarding session (no charge). Draft external note: "Hi AstraMetrics  we found that an internal test API key was mistakenly promoted to production during an experiment rollout which caused repeated requests and the surge charge. We've reversed the surge ($9,600) and added a $300 goodwill credit; your updated invoice AMT-8811-v2 is published. We've rolled back the experiment, added an automated guard to prevent test keys from being flagged in prod, and can schedule a free re-onboarding to ensure your workflows are stable. Sorry for the disruption. - Leo, Account Ops"

mira: Please include a contact for escalation and note when the credit will appear. Also add "affected-request-ids" list for their audit.

leo: Updated and sent at 2026-12-05T16:02Z. Customer reply: "Thanks for handling this so fast. The re-onboarding offer is helpful. We'll take you up on that next week."

sarah: I'll open a postmortem with eng-experiments and ops to document the mapping bug and the new guard. Tagging Jen and Ops.

jen: Filing PR to add test-key whitelist check and writing unit tests. PR link: https://git.redwood.com/repo/PR-4890.

ops-bot: [automated] Incident created INC-2026-212 for experiment misflag; severity S2.

sarah: Thanks team  closing thread.
